connector_gender_evidence.source: User identified this as the LLC cable and supplied a mating-face photo showing socket contacts.

connector_pcb_mount: B.Cu, straight outward from underside; PG9 panel support required
source_caveats: The drawing title is LLC-13M-1 whereas the filename is LLC16_13M_1; the supplied drawing is the design basis, not proof of measured cable continuity.
The drawing lists NorComp with a TE part number; select the PCB mate from its own verified manufacturer documentation.
RJ45 BD-/CD- names conflict with numeric wiring; design uses the drawn M12 4 to RJ45 6 connection, not the label BD-.
release_blockers: Supplier must confirm exact MB12MBAFF08ST-3, furnished pin view / finished holes, actual cable mating and B-side mounting orientation; no automatic substitution.
Validate PG9 panel support, connector seating height, cable bend access and PCB standoff mechanics before fabrication.
Obtain JLC sourcing and complete Standard PCBA approval for the male connector and edge SMA; no user hand-soldering assumed.
Confirm production stack-up / controlled impedance / SMA board-thickness fit, CAM and final ten-board quote.
before_first_vna_connection: Disconnect all active equipment and power tails; verify the passive DUT has no applied or residual voltage.
Check cable continuity against the design map, including M12 4 to RJ45 6, and check isolation from power pins 1/5/6/7.
Record actual shell/shield connections and select the documented shield condition before REF/DUT measurements.
